tr: Dengan menyebut nama Allah Yang Maha Pemurah lagi Maha Penyayang.
en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

tr: Segala puji bagi Allah, Tuhan semesta alam.
en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

tr: Hanya Engkaulah yang kami sembah, dan hanya kepada Engkaulah kami meminta pertolongan.
en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path -

t: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
tr: (yaitu) Jalan orang-orang yang telah Engkau beri nikmat kepada mereka; bukan (jalan) mereka yang dimurkai dan bukan (pula jalan) mereka yang sesat.
en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
